name: Beipan River Guanxing Highway Bridge
facts: The Beipan River Guanxing Highway Bridge, opened in 2003, stood 366 metres above the Beipan River, becoming the world's highest bridge until Papua New Guinea's Hegigio Gorge Pipeline Bridge claimed the title in 2005.
As the first suspension bridge to exceed both 300 metres and 1,000 feet in height, it shattered Colorado's Royal Gorge Bridge record after a 74‑year reign, cementing China’s engineering prowess.

Constructed on the Guanxing Highway near Xingbei Town, the bridge’s 388‑metre span links the two banks of the Beipan River, dramatically shortening travel between Zhenfeng County and neighboring regions.
